rows.grounds: compound gūḍha plus sadbhāva, accusative singular

items.question: What arises for one who knows that hidden true nature?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature causes all-knowingness.
Taṃ refers to hidden true nature.
items.inference: All-knowingness arises from knowing the hidden true nature.
uncertainties: Gender and number of taṃ and gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ are not fully fixed by context.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
